preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of provinces N in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of destroyed roads M must be between 0 and the minimum of N*(N-1)/2 and 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to deploy the senas for each test case.
There must be at least one valid way to deploy the senas.
The number of ways to deploy the senas must not exceed 2.
